Metadata.title: When Does Rainbow Six Siege Season End? | R6 Live Countdown
Metadata.description: Live countdown to Rainbow Six Siege Operation Vital Signal (Y11S4), launching December 1, 2026. Track the current season end date, the next season start and the Year 12 Season 1 estimate.

Article.title: Operation Vital Signal (Y11S4): Season Dates & Guide
Article.completion_desc:
Rainbow Six Siege Operation Split Fire (Year 11 Season 3) ends on December 1, 2026, when Operation Vital Signal (Year 11 Season 4) goes live on PC, PlayStation and Xbox.

New seasons deploy after a maintenance window, usually starting around 09:00 AM ET (14:00 UTC); Ubisoft confirms the exact time shortly before launch. Vital Signal is the last season of Year 11 and is expected to run until early March 2027 — Siege seasons last about 91 days, which puts the estimated end around March 2, 2027.
Article.next_desc:
Vital Signal brings Ranked 3.0, splitting Ranked into separate Solo/Duo and Flex queues.

Your final rank of the season determines your seasonal rewards, so play your last Ranked matches before the maintenance starts and avoid queuing in the final 30 minutes to prevent abandon penalties. The current Battle Pass also ends when the new season launches, so claim your remaining rewards first.
Article.checklist_1: Finish the current Battle Pass before Dec 1
Article.checklist_2: Play your last Ranked matches early
Article.checklist_3: Log in daily for Winter Rewards (Dec 1 – Jan 15)

FAQ.title: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQ.q1: When does the current Rainbow Six Siege season end?
FAQ.a1: Operation Split Fire (Y11S3) ends on December 1, 2026, when Operation Vital Signal (Y11S4) launches. Vital Signal is expected to end in early March 2027 (estimated March 2, 2027, based on the 91-day season cycle). The countdown above always shows the live timer for the current season.
FAQ.q2: What's new in Operation Vital Signal?
FAQ.a2: Operation Vital Signal brings a Doc remaster, Ranked 3.0 with separate Solo/Duo and Flex queues, the new MBZ-19 SMG for Jäger, Warden and Thunderbird, a targeted update for Bank, modernized versions of Yacht, Favela and Tower, and limited-time events such as The Grand Larceny.
FAQ.q3: Do Battle Pass rewards carry over?
FAQ.a3: No. The current Battle Pass ends when the new season starts, so unlock your remaining rewards before Operation Vital Signal launches on December 1. Ubisoft reminds players that the launch date is also the deadline for the current pass.
FAQ.a4: Yes. Your cosmetics, renown, credits, and operators are shared across all platforms (PC, Xbox, PlayStation) as long as your accounts are linked to the same Ubisoft Connect ID. However, rank progression is separate between PC and Console pools.

Updates.meta_description: Everything coming in Rainbow Six Siege Operation Vital Signal (Y11S4): Doc remaster, Ranked 3.0 Solo/Duo and Flex queues, MBZ-19 SMG, Bank update, modernized maps and events.
Updates.title: Season Updates & Intelligence
Updates.section_1_title: Y11S4 Operation Vital Signal: Full Breakdown
Updates.section_1_desc: Operation Vital Signal, the final season of Year 11, launches on December 1, 2026 (Test Server from November 16). It focuses on core tactical gameplay and competitive play. Here is everything Ubisoft has announced.
Updates.change_1_point_1: New healing gadget that can be activated remotely.
Updates.change_1_point_2: Can heal and revive downed teammates without exposing himself.
Updates.change_2_point_1: Ranked is split into separate Solo/Duo and Flex queues.
Updates.change_3_point_2: Available to Jäger, Warden and Thunderbird.
Updates.change_4_point_1: Receives a set of upgrades this season.
Updates.change_4_point_2: Gains access to the new MBZ-19.
Updates.change_5_point_1: Rework of the Back Alley area where Attackers enter.
Updates.change_5_point_2: Changes how Defenders play and control the 2F objectives.
Updates.change_6_point_1: Yacht, Favela and Tower get visual and gameplay improvements.
Updates.change_6_point_2: Continues the Modernized Maps initiative of Year 11.
Updates.change_7_point_1: Try Half-Reinforcements as a secondary gadget.
Updates.change_7_point_2: Still in development: your feedback shapes the final version.
Updates.change_8_point_1: Limited-time events: Freeze For All: Permafrost and The Grand Larceny.
Updates.change_9_point_1: DOOM crossover with a DOOM Slayer Elite set.
Updates.change_9_point_2: Winter Daily Rewards for logging in from December 1 to January 15.
Updates.section_2_desc: Year 12 Season 1 is expected in early March 2027 (estimated around March 2, based on the 91-day season cycle). Ubisoft usually reveals the full yearly roadmap at the Six Invitational in February. Doc is the last Operator remaster before the game moves to adding four new Operators per year.
Updates.rumor_alert_desc: Year 12 dates are estimates. We update the countdown as soon as Ubisoft confirms them.
